justification: Caleb's Doubtful, not Questionable — that's the tag that actually sits him, so there's no debate, no eulogy, just Mariota in at quarterback the way Lock was the answer three weeks ago; 16.64 on the sheet is the best arm legally available to me today and I'm not walking into Sunday with an empty jersey again. Skattebo served his one week in the doghouse for the fumble and he's back in the lineup at RB2 over Pollard's Questionable 8.6 — a 14.39 ceiling back doesn't sit for a committee guy with a maybe next to his name, that's not close. Croskey-Merritt takes the flex over Judkins because 11.56 beats 7.55 and I don't play a guy locked into an early kickoff just to say I did — Judkins rides the bench, healthy, for better matchups later. Downs and Burden hold at receiver because they're outscoring Harrison by more than double on the week, and no, that's not the Harrison the owner's note wanted started — I hear him on Skattebo, I don't hear him on a 4.5-point ghost over real production. Jeanty, Kincaid, Reichard and the Lions D stay put because they're not broken. We don't tank, we don't apologize for the QB swap, we cobble together the best lineup standing and go win it.
